data.rationale: The proposed workflow has the right steps in the right order: Careers, Openings, then the country, team and time type filters with search-and-select, then search and opening the job; however, it uses a job_title parameter where the true workflow has an action parameter (open or save), so it treats applying as optional and leaves out the save choice.
